features.quote: End on `submit`, on a step budget (`max_steps`), on a tool-call cap (`max_tool_calls`), or on error
features.justification_quote: Impossible tasks invite infinite flailing; hard budgets bound cost and guarantee termination.

features.quote: a no-op turn gets one nudge before ending
features.justification_quote: distinguishes "model is done but forgot to submit" from a genuine stall without letting it loop forever
